    DuckDB function postgres_configure_pool().

  max_lifetime_millis,
  enable_reaper_thread,
  enable_thread_local_cache,
  wait_timeout_millis,
  max_connections,
  idle_timeout_millis,
  acquire_mode,
  catalog_name
